name: gdpr
title: GDPR readiness for AI systems
note: Control mappings are the author's reading of each provision, written to make engineering readiness checkable. They are not legal advice and do not decide what a regulation requires of you. Check the text and your counsel, and edit this file to match their view.

controls.title: Lawful basis recorded
controls.remedy: Record the Article 6 lawful basis for each purpose, and the legitimate-interests assessment where that is the basis.

controls.title: Data minimisation reviewed
controls.remedy: Review that the personal data used is adequate, relevant and limited to what the purpose needs.

controls.title: Retention schedule defined
controls.remedy: Define how long each kind of personal data is kept and how it is deleted.

controls.title: Accountable owner named
controls.remedy: Name the person accountable for the processing and keep the evidence that the principles are met.

controls.title: Privacy notice published
controls.remedy: Tell people what you process, why, on what basis, for how long and what their rights are.

controls.title: Data subject rights process operational
controls.remedy: Run a process to answer access, correction, erasure and objection requests within the deadline.

controls.title: Safeguards for automated decisions
controls.requires: present(evidence.automated_decision_safeguards) and evidence.automated_decision_safeguards.values.human_intervention == true and evidence.automated_decision_safeguards.values.can_contest == true and evidence.automated_decision_safeguards.values.explanation_available == true
controls.remedy: Give people a way to obtain human intervention, express their view and contest a decision that has legal or similarly significant effect.

controls.title: Data protection by design and by default
controls.remedy: Build data protection into the design and set the defaults to the least data needed.

controls.title: Records of processing activities
controls.remedy: Maintain the record of processing activities and keep it current.

controls.title: Security of processing
controls.remedy: Document the technical and organisational measures that fit the risk, and test them.

controls.title: Breach notification procedure
controls.remedy: Be able to assess a breach and notify the supervisory authority within 72 hours where required.

controls.title: Data protection impact assessment
controls.applies: system.personal_data == true and (system.automated_decisions == true or system.risk_class == "high")
controls.requires: present(evidence.dpia) and evidence.dpia.values.completed == true and evidence.dpia.values.residual_risk_accepted == true
controls.remedy: Complete a DPIA before the processing starts, consult the supervisory authority if high residual risk remains, and review it.
